label: TSMM to Verifiable Trust Communities binding
description: Maps Verifiable Trust Communities (VTC) extension concepts into TSMM abstractions so community-governed trust structures can be indexed and compared consistently.

mappings.description: Community-bounded trust domain governed by explicit participation and policy expectations.
Authority defining participation conditions, review rules, and remediation expectations.
Registry-like publication and lookup surface for community state and member status.
Credential or attestable artifact expressing community membership or standing.
Downstream consumer that depends on community trust state to produce effects.

notes: The VTC extension is modeled as a specialized trust domain with additional governance and membership semantics.
This binding makes the extension publishable in the same registry vocabulary as core TSMM graphs and external ecosystem bindings.
